summary: ZenaTech, Inc. filed a Form 6-K containing an amended Management's Discussion and Analysis (MD&A) for the three months ended March 31, 2026. The amendment adds clarity regarding loans made by the company, with no changes to the original MD&A disclosures or financial statements. This is a routine financial reporting update, not a special situation event. No merger, acquisition, tender offer, restructuring, or other transformative corporate action is described. The filing is a standard periodic report by a foreign private issuer, incorporating by reference into an existing F-3 registration statement.
